Name: Bulk Animal Purchase
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod you can choose to purchase more than one farm animal at a time.

You will still be presented with a naming dialogue for each animal.

Cows and chickens will be coloured randomly as in the vanilla game.

After placing all but the last animal, Marnie's confirmation dialogue will be converted into a HUD message to allow the process to continue.

After placing the last animal successfully, you will be returned to Marnie's store and she will speak her confirmation dialogue about the last animal.

You can quit the process before placing all animals by exiting the placement menu as normal.



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
